original_test_intent: Measure bit-error behavior of each approved PCIe Gen5 NVIDIA signal path with the vendor BER FCT and verify lane/path results against a documented statistical threshold while retaining SUT usability.
original_method: Pin NVDiag BER module/config, stable endpoint/upstream/retimer/lane topology and Gen5 xN state; define traffic pattern, rate, sample duration/bit count, lane aggregation and threshold/confidence policy; preserve error baseline; drain jobs; run approved measurement under telemetry/watchdog, capture raw counts and derived BER per scope, stop on instability, then verify link/GPU/error and SUT recovery.
manual_activity: PCIe/signal-integrity owner supplies BER pattern/statistical threshold, target lane/path and vendor module policy, approves stress/recovery and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Stable endpoint/upstream/retimer/switch/lane topology and Gen5 width
Traffic pattern/direction/rate and sample duration or total bits
BER threshold, lane aggregation, zero-error confidence/upper-bound and SKU exception rules
Dedicated window, telemetry, OOB, abort and recovery plan
safety_requirements: No floating package or generic traffic substitution
Verify exact link/lane target and baseline before stress
Abort on escalating error, retrain, reset, link loss or unsafe telemetry
Preserve raw counters and first failure; never clear or automatically retry
agent_execution_scope: Run approved BER measurement once per required path
Calculate and present defined BER/upper bound and health deltas
Stop/recover and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve module, pattern, sample size, threshold/confidence and lane scope
Approve SKU exception/recovery and interpret marginal/error results

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the pinned vendor `pcie_gen5_ber` FCT against the confirmed path/lane scope with approved pattern/sample policy; preserve complete unfiltered counters and log.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record per-path/lane bits, raw errors, duration/rate and computed BER or zero-error upper confidence bound, correlated with link/error telemetry and full vendor result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes pass quantitatively reproducible instead of trusting an unqualified diagnostic string.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Linkup, bandwidth or generic load cannot establish BER measurement coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Zero observed errors gives only an upper bound dependent on sample size; it is not mathematical zero and cannot meet a threshold without sufficient bits.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines Gen5 BER FCT; quantitative parameters are missing prerequisites rather than contradictory source branches.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor module, topology and statistical oracle are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Converts a generic pass string into an auditable statistical BER measurement with per-lane/path scope and safe first-failure handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: BER is errors divided by observed bits, so neither a clean log nor zero observed errors is meaningful without total bits and scope. A short run can report zero yet have an upper bound above the required threshold. Lane aggregation can hide a failing lane behind other clean lanes; therefore raw per-lane evidence and an approved aggregation/confidence rule are required, along with link-state and error-log correlation because retraining can invalidate the sample.
